data.title: 丛雨 · 廊下纸灯的微风小坐
data.description: 夏夜神社长廊外萤火点点，丛雨披着绯红金纹短羽织坐在温润的木廊边，两条白皙小腿在廊檐外轻轻晃荡。她怀里抱起一盏微亮的纸提灯凑近脸颊，红穗流苏随夜风轻摆，鼓着小脸催你快坐过来一起纳凉讲故事。
data.location: 萤火微闪的夏夜神社木质回廊
data.action: 坐于木廊边缘轻晃双脚，怀抱纸灯偏头催促招手
data.lighting: 手里暖橘纸提灯照亮面容与短羽织金纹，背景是幽蓝夏夜
data.camera: 平视中景，回廊木柱与点点萤光营造纵深
data.mood: 灵动、亲昵、微带刀灵小傲娇
data.promptProse: Sitting along the wooden veranda of the quiet shrine on a summer night, Murasame swings her bare feet over the edge while cradling a warm paper lantern near her chest. Fireflies drift through the dark garden behind her as lantern glow illuminates the gold embroidery on her crimson short haori and white sarashi wrap.
data.animaCaption: Seated barefoot on the shrine veranda with fireflies behind her, she holds a glowing paper lantern and smiles playfully.
